_note: Every sauna and cold-plunge business we know about in Canada (checked 7 Nov 2026), plus studios abroad to compare (added 8 Nov 2026). track: 'marianatek', 'ferb' or 'momence' = collect.py reads places booked from its public schedule; 'madre' = only a busy label per time is public (data/slots-*.csv); 'later' = could be tracked with a different reader; 'cannot' = no public numbers to read; 'not_open' = not open yet. include_types / include_locations / exclude_locations limit what's counted (case-insensitive text match). price_per_visit_cad = what an average visit brings in (members pay less than drop-ins). For Tality it comes from the price mix; for the others it's an estimate of 45–65% of the drop-in price, the same ratio as Tality.
